scenarios.title: Edit and save every task detail
given: The seeded task Finalize the product roadmap is visible
when: The user changes title, notes, category, priority, and due date
then: The updated title and metadata are displayed
The original title is no longer displayed

scenarios.title: Cancel discards task edits
then: The draft title is not displayed

scenarios.title: Blank titles cannot be saved
given: A task is in edit mode
when: The user replaces its title with whitespace
then: The existing task is not overwritten

scenarios.title: Saved edits persist after reload
given: A user has saved a valid title edit
then: The edited title is still displayed
The original title does not return

scenarios.title: Editing is accessible and existing actions still work
when: The user locates its descriptively named edit action
The user opens the editor and inspects its labeled controls
The user cancels and completes the task
then: Title, notes, category, priority, and due-date controls have accessible names
